intent: Make the CI trigger set proportional to the diff. 33 of 48 workflows fire on pull_request and only 5 carried a paths filter, so any push launched ~28 runs regardless of content; the per-account runner allowance then queued them against every other PR (measured 676-deep on 2026-08-07). Filters 13 advisory workflows at the workflow level and 6 advisory tests.yml jobs at the job level. The required pytest contexts stay unconditional, because a required check that does not run never reports and branch protection waits on it forever.

','  pull_request:

',1)); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_workflow_path_filters.py::test_no_required_workflow_carries_a_paths_filter'],check=False); p.write_text(t); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode!=0 else 1)"

commit.message: perf(ci): path-filter 13 advisory workflows and 6 advisory tests.yml jobs

interface_mismatches: tests.yml mixed two REQUIRED pytest contexts with six advisory jobs behind a single trigger, so no workflow-level paths filter could reduce it without risking a required context that never reports. Split at the job level instead.
honest_blockers: CEREMONY ORDER WAS VIOLATED AND THIS RECEIPT SAYS SO. The change was authored, committed and pushed before this packet existed; the packet-scope gate failing on PR #1285 is what prompted it. Read the binding as a scope-CONFORMANCE check, not as evidence that scope was declared first.

Before/after run counts are from a local approximation of GitHub's glob engine, not from GitHub. If the engines disagree on any pattern a workflow may not fire where I predicted. Mitigated but not eliminated by the required-context guard.

structure.yml and manifest-check.yml are deliberately unfiltered: structure.yml must see any new root file, and I could not bound manifest-check's scope honestly. Guessing there is the AI-N4 shape this change otherwise guards.
The classifier is exercised by unit tests and one real-git rename case, not against a live GitHub pull_request payload.
session_entry.rollback: Single revert. CI returns to ~28 runs per PR event; no gate changes meaning.
